name: search_icons
description: Search IconSaga icons by meaning, in the user's own language (English, Thai, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Indonesian or mixed). Also takes an icon name as UI icon sets write it (arrow-right, circle-check, shopping-cart, trash-2, HomeIcon) and returns the matching icon first. Returns icon ids, labels, versions, styles and licence per icon.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: What the icon should show, e.g. "invoice", "ลูกศรซ้าย", "carrito de compras", "地図のピン", "home บ้าน"

arguments.name: style
arguments.desc: Only icons available in this style

arguments.name: set
arguments.desc: Only icons of this set (see list_sets)

arguments.name: lang
arguments.desc: Language of the labels in the answer: en, th, es, pt-BR, fr, de, ja, zh-Hans, ko or id (regions and names such as pt, zh-CN, ja-JP or "Japanese" also work). Default: the language of the query

name: get_icon
description: SVG of one icon in a style, two colours and a stroke weight, and code to save in a project: code "tsx" (default) is a React component (size, className and title props; main colour currentColor so text colour classes work; accent from the CSS variable --icon-accent), "html" an inline SVG snippet, "svg" the file only. format "svg" is a still icon (1-2 filled paths, works in PowerPoint, Figma, web); "anim-svg" plays its motion in browsers with no player or script.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Icon id from search_icons (old ids still work)

arguments.name: accent
arguments.desc: Accent colour for the duo style, hex like #FFB020

arguments.name: weight
arguments.desc: Stroke weight for line and duo, 0.5-2.5. Default auto: by size when you give one (24 px = 1.75, 48 = 1.25, 128+ = 0.75), else 1.25

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: anim-svg only: loop (default), once, or hover

arguments.name: code
arguments.desc: tsx (default): a React component · html: an inline SVG snippet · svg: the SVG file only

arguments.name: lang
arguments.desc: Language of the label and licence link (as in search_icons). Default en

name: match_icons
description: Many icon names at once, as a project's UI icon set writes them (arrow-right, circle-check, shopping-cart, trash-2, HomeIcon), each with the closest IconSaga icon: to swap the icons of a whole project in one call. match is "name" (a known name), "search" (found by meaning) or "none". Then get_icon for the code of each.

arguments.name: style
arguments.desc: Only icons available in this style

arguments.name: lang
arguments.desc: Language of the labels (as in search_icons). Default en

name: list_sets
description: All icon sets with how many icons each has.

arguments.name: lang
arguments.desc: Language of the set names (as in search_icons). Default en
